body: Green dust sits in the tire pump's nozzle. The tarp wrapped around it is streaked where a wheel crossed from one field to another.
title: The wheel's other field

body: This shovel carries two soils: red clay under a fresh layer of pale dust. The bucket has only the pale stuff.
title: The spare shovel

body: The bottom rung is crusted with fertilizer. The clean top rung still has flakes from a different barn's paint.
title: The borrowed ladder

body: The duct tape holds a split hose together. Its inner edge is green; the water bottle beneath the patch is flecked the same way.
title: The patched hose

body: One corner was folded inward while still wet. Under the crease the field grit is green, but the exposed side is rain-washed.
title: The return tarp

body: The seed bag is torn across the bottom. The loose grain in the floor mat has the same black dust as the tear.
title: The load under the seat

body: Someone tied this broom to the outside of a load. Its bristles hold straw from one pen and dark pellets from another.
title: The tied broom

body: The hose is coiled around the wheel; the water from washing it has pooled green in the bucket. The other wheel stayed dry.
title: The washed wheel

body: A knot still carries pale dust, but the free end has a dark crust. This rope has been tied around more than one load.
title: The handoff rope

body: The spade blade was rinsed, leaving a strip of green soil in the socket where the water could not reach.
title: The clean blade
